description:
Notifly is a marketing automation platform for sending and managing customer messages across channels such as mobile push, web push, popups, email, SMS, KakaoTalk, and webhooks.
Teams can build behavior-based campaigns and user journeys, personalize audiences, review delivery and conversion performance, and connect Notifly through SDKs, HTTP APIs, and external integrations.
